summary: Conditional dispatcher: when a bitmap-range occupancy test on a2 succeeds, appends via sub_584DD0(this, a2); otherwise it dispatches through vtable slot 44 (obj+0x2C), runs sub_584230(this, a2), then dispatches through vtable slot 92 (obj+0x5C). Always returns 1.

operations.description: Occupied path: append via sub_584DD0(this, a2).
Free path: dispatch through vtable slot 44 at obj+0x2C with (this, a2).
Free path: process via sub_584230(this, a2).
Free path: dispatch through vtable slot 92 at obj+0x5C with (this, a2).
Read the vtable pointer from this+0 to resolve the dispatched slot functions.
Return the constant success value 1 on both paths.

unresolved: The purpose of the bitmap occupancy test and the identities of the two dispatched vtable slots are caller-dependent and unproven.
